question: Building on S5, can exact search finish 16-state worlds, and can Brute recover the exact machine (ID) at 12 and 16 states, and is ID limited by search or by what the trace can tell apart?
motivation: Study 030 (Observed): S5 cleared 12 states (U 0.047 [0.004, 0.093] vs S1 0.200; X 5/12 [0.19, 0.68]; GSC5 PASS) but finished 0/12 at 16 states (U 0.240 [0.171, 0.308]). ID was 0/12 at 12 and 16 states for every arm even though identify ran on all 24 S5 cases there, and only 6/12 at 8 states where X was 12/12. Inferred: at 8 states some traces admit more than one consistent machine, so ID is bounded by identifiability as well as by search; the 030 instruments cannot separate the two. The hard cap did not explain the 030 gain (S5 vs S5_softcap -0.001 [-0.009, 0.006]). S5 was worse on noisy 12-state traces (stress U 0.585 vs S4 0.370; not gated).

arms.S6: S5 plus two pre-declared changes aimed at 16 states: (1) one incremental solver per step, with each query's region clauses guarded by an activation literal and solved under assumptions, so learned clauses carry across queries and the per-query rebuild cost (S5 build_skips mean 118.9 at scale16) is removed; (2) queries ordered by ascending candidate-region size, so cheap queries spend budget first. Same hard cap as S5. Plus the identify probe below
arms.S5: v0.27.0 arm, unchanged in search (control); identify probe applied identically
arms.S6_noorder: ablation: S6 without query ordering (separates incremental reuse from ordering)

design.identify_probe: after search, identify asks for a second consistent machine that is not isomorphic to the first (blocking clause on the first machine's canonical relabelling). Each case gets one label: ID (exactly one class, equal to truth), AMB (two or more non-isomorphic consistent machines found: the trace does not identify the machine), WRONG (single class not equal to truth: a soundness failure), IDU (identify ran out of budget). Identify budget 60 s per case, outside the step budget, the same for every arm
design.same_budget: 55 s per step, 10 s per query cap, as in studies 028-030
design.soundness: every S6 certificate rechecked by the frozen exact reference; any mismatch with S1/S5 or truth on an answered query is a FAIL; any WRONG is a FAIL

heldout_ranges.note: Fresh ranges following the study-number convention (030 used 96x0001). Drawn only after a ledgered seedcheck_031 confirms they are disjoint from every earlier plan, result and sealed archive. Pre-plan scan (Observed): no token in these ranges in tracked text files.

cases.stress: first 3 seeds of scale12 and scale16 at eps 0.05 = 6 (F gated; U reported)

GSC6_headline.a: 0 mismatches of S6 vs S1/S5 and vs truth on answered queries
GSC6_headline.b: U(S6, scale16) - U(S5, scale16) <= -0.06, paired seed-bootstrap 95% CI upper bound < 0

GID6.c: IDU(S6, scale12) <= 2/12 (so an ID shortfall is attributable to AMB, not to budget)

criteria.GQB6: S6 max query time <= 10.5 s on every case
criteria.G10: S6 U=0 and ID 6/6 on controls
criteria.informational: S6 vs S6_noorder U difference; S6 vs S1; ID/AMB/IDU at scale8 and scale16; stress U at eps 0.05 for all arms (030 showed S5 worse there); throughput ratios; reported, not gated

runtime_estimate: about 1300 s on 8 workers (54 cases; 4 arms plus a 60 s identify probe per case; study 030 took 978.9 s for 51 cases); the cap is 1800 s and G_RT fails above it
what_counts_as_failure: any GSC6 or GID6 clause failing, GQB6 above 10.5 s, any false certificate or WRONG identification; failures are published, not tuned
limitations: noise-free masks for the headline; eps 0.05 stress gates F only
one hardware profile, one author; no independent replication
AMB depends on the identify budget; an AMB label is a lower bound on non-identifiability only when the second machine is found
if S6 fails GSC6, 16 states remain open and the next bottleneck must be measured, not assumed
